That is scripts/test-sluice-vet.sh, a test I added earlier tonight for the vet's cross-branch decision-number check. Your candidate vetted clean — 0 behind main, block 636-645 reserved, nothing minted, no risky surfaces, +2060/-16 — and the failing suite has nothing to do with your work. It runs in the outboard phase, which every candidate pays for, so my broken test is currently blocking the queue for everyone.

WHY IT BREAKS, and it is a good example of a test asserting something about the world that was only briefly true. The negative control picks a campaign branch, takes a decision number from `git diff origin/main...<branch>`, and asserts origin/main does NOT carry it. A three-dot diff is against the MERGE BASE, so a number stays in that diff after the campaign lands — and then main DOES carry it, and the control fires correctly while the assertion calls it a failure.

It passed when I wrote it because at that moment no branch it picked had landed. Fifteen campaigns have landed since. The test encoded "a minted decision is not on main", which is true only before that campaign merges.

I am fixing it now and will submit as soon as it is green. Resubmit whenever you like — your SHA is fine and will pass once my fix lands. Sorry for the slot.
